properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations) declared transitively via elliptic in the Hardhat/Ethereum toolchain. Available in the shipped dependency tree; no direct call site found in application source. SHA-1 is legacy; quantum impact on hashes is Grover-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Native secp256k1 package (bundled under ganache-core, plus @types/secp256k1) across the four Hardhat/Web3Modal lockfiles. secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum account signature scheme — every transaction these dApps send is signed with it. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); app-level signing can move to ML-DSA but on-chain verification is fixed by the chain protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Site is `await fetch("https://randomuser.me/api/")` — a browser-side fetch in a React hook, not a Node.js client, so TLS group configuration is the browser's default (current Chrome/Firefox negotiate hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 against capable servers; randomuser.me's support unknown). Runtime label corrected, but the outbound runtime-default TLS session is real and is this app's only network dependency.
